name: Twist 'n Turn Hyd Open 2025
information: All the participants are expected to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events. **ALL PARTICIPANTS HAVE TO BE AT THE VENUE ATLEAST 45 MINUTES BEFORE THE START OF THEIR EVENT. LATE COMERS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE.** Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.
